title: Shear automorphism
statement: For a natural number $m$, the map $(x,(a,b))\mapsto(x,(a+s(x),b+s(x)))$, where $s(x)$ is the sum of the coordinates of $x$, is regarded as a linear equivalence of the product of the $m$-coordinate space with $mathbb{F}_2^2$ to itself.
